If x>=y, u<=v and is bottleneck; for k<n the continuous centered benchmark B obeys B-u(d)=λ(1−λ)d(c−λd)/[2c(D0+λ²d²/4)], strictly positive for d>0. Thus even budget uniquely balanced; for odd k the derivative of the defect has sign of strictly decreasing Q(d), so u has no interior strict local max and a discrete maximizer is either near-balanced or one-shore. Exact endpoint subtraction has sign of F_{n,k}=2n−(k+1)λ−(2n+1−k)λ², giving one sharp threshold λ*. If n<=k<2n, every non-source support<=λ, equality exactly when S includes a full shore; full graph k=2n has support 1. Binomial counts match profiles. Independent exact rational enumeration of all profiles n=2..9 for four λ values (352 parameter instances), and explicit K4,4 λ=9/10, supports the analytic classification.
